meta.title: EmpowerEd
meta.seoDescription: EmpowerEd develops bottom-up, collaborative interventions to educate and empower educators.

overview.title: Overview
overview.body: EmpowerEd develops bottom-up, collaborative interventions to educate, enrich and empower educators. It treats teachers as experts — not recipients — of professional development.

components.title: Community of Practitioners
components.desc: Fortnightly dialogue sessions, small-group projects, action research, reading groups, and best-practice documentation.

components.title: Immersive Teacher Empowerment App
components.desc: Rich storytelling and game-based decision-making scenarios rooted in diverse household experiences.

objectives.sectionSubtitle: The pillars that guide EmpowerEd's work with teachers

timeline.sectionSubtitle: A phased approach to scaling teacher empowerment
phases: Phase 2 (Nov 2022–Jun 2024): Pre-pilot with ~50 teachers; app pilot with ~10,000 teachers
Phase 3 (Jun 2024–Jun 2025): Scale to ~100,000 teachers across one Indian state
Phase 4 (Jun 2025–Jun 2028): Expand to 10–30 million teachers across India and internationally
